purpose.summary: This program manages supplier price lists ('listini fornitori') for an Italian ERP system called Geslux. It handles creation, modification, copying, and printing of supplier offer/price-list records, including articles, discounts, taxes, lead times, and destination-specific pricing. It is generated by the TOTEM RAD framework for ACUCOBOL-GT.
